title: Lab label GET increments sample row_version and print count, but endpoint omits this side effect
actual: In fresh synthetic req1/sample2, collect returned a label. GET /lab/scan showed Collected label_print_count1 row_version3. The frontend read GET /lab/samples/2/label for preview; the next scan showed count2 row_version4 with unchanged clinical status. A receipt review correctly refused its stale snapshot before POST. get_endpoint describes only Re-print a sample barcode label and required permission; write_semantics null, no note that reads mutate the sample or need refresh.
expected: Document that obtaining this label is a counted reprint with row_version side effects, including whether cancelled printing still counts; or provide a nonmutating preview if intended. Clients need to call it only on deliberate print/reprint and refresh the sample before a clinical action. We fixed our automatic-preview defect accordingly; no need to weaken concurrency or fabricate a version.
steps: Fresh own synthetic Lab-only order paid by virtual Card. Collect sample2 with actual own patient band. GET scan LB-2026-0000002 -> count1/version3. GET samples/2/label ->200. GET scan -> count2/version4. No receive POST occurred. Read current get_endpoint label: no mutation warning.
